Interface RetainedEventLoopGroups

@Internal public interface RetainedEventLoopGroups
Event loop groups that outlive the DefaultEventLoopGroupRegistry that asked for them. The registry asks for a group by name instead of creating it, when the group runs on the framework's own threads: no executor bean, no thread factory bean, no loom carriers and no task queue interceptors, none of which may outlive the context that created them. When the registry shuts down, the groups it was handed are left running.

Development mode provides it, so that the event loops of the HTTP servers and clients, their threads and their selectors, are kept while one generation of the application stops and the next one starts. What runs on them, the channels, their pipelines and their handlers, is each generation's own.

Since:
5.3.0

    • eventLoopGroup

      io.netty.channel.EventLoopGroup eventLoopGroup(String name, EventLoopGroupConfiguration configuration, EventLoopGroupFactory factory, Supplier<io.netty.channel.EventLoopGroup> create)
      The group retained under a name, when it was made from the same settings by the same kind of factory, or the one create makes, retained from then on unless the configuration or the factory is not one that may outlive the context.
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the group
      configuration - The configuration it is made from, whose settings it is retained for, and whose shutdown periods apply when it is released
      factory - The factory that makes its I/O handlers and channels
      create - Creates the group when none is retained under the name for these settings
      Returns:
      The group
